purpose: Map infrastructures that make hidden denominator, planned analyses, result-reporting status, formal corrections, or anomaly signals visible without treating any layer as complete.

rows.label: ClinicalTrials.gov
rows.captures: study existence, status, NCT identifier, PRS workflow, summary results where posted
rows.known_limits: not all trials; missing/late results; discrepancies require audit

rows.label: WHO ICTRP
rows.captures: registry data sets from qualified providers; primary-registry criteria; TRDS
rows.known_limits: not itself a registry; depends on providers; not result-reporting guarantee

rows.label: OSF Registries
rows.captures: plans, files, metadata, timestamps, DOIs, embargo/public state

rows.label: AsPredicted
rows.captures: timestamped PDFs, unique URLs, public immutable records, private-forever option
rows.known_limits: private records do not reveal denominator or results

rows.label: AEA RCT Registry
rows.captures: protocols, instruments, findings links, version history, lifecycle reminders
rows.known_limits: scope limited; publication/result linkage requires audit

rows.label: Registered Reports
rows.captures: protocol peer review before outcomes, in-principle acceptance

rows.label: PubPeer
rows.known_limits: comments are not verdicts; coverage/user-attention biased

rows.label: Practice-lag/de-adoption surfaces
rows.visibility_layer: visible negative evidence versus visible practice change
rows.captures: a negative result may be published while practice remains; de-adoption requires rails and utilization tracking
rows.known_limits: new lane is first-pass only; child records required

guardrail: Visibility is not completeness. A registry/comment/correction surface is a linkable signal class, not an automatic verdict.
rev0009_related_pattern: MKH-PAT-0009 uses denominator-visibility infrastructure as one input, but focuses on empirical audit pairs rather than platform existence.
